page.overview:
What is Imperial Magic Academy?

Like in many others countries of the Continent, even the Nilfgaardian Empire owns a Magic Academy where mages are taught. Emhyr var Emreis, Imperator of Nilfgaard, hired many mages in his court from this school. While the academy is located near Loc Grim, another academy is located in Vicovaro.

While the vast majority of students pass through Gweison Hall, the more prestigious children of the Empire are sometimes extended the opportunity to study at the Imperial Magic Academy. This royal academy was created to train the highest echelon of Nilfgaard's magical community. The students of the Imperial Magic Academy are not as stricly controlled as the students of Gweison Haul. In almost all case the students who graduate from the Imperial Magic Academy can join the army as adjudants, acting as advisors or are employed by their family.

Some students of marginal abilites from wealthy families may be admitted to the Imperial Magic Academy after an appropriate contribution to the school.

Each student receives a lavish personal room and the school is staffed by servants who are at the student beck and call. During the holidays, the Academy hosts feasts and celebrations on par with those of the capital.
